name: Amtrak Acela — Origins and development
title: Amtrak Acela: Origins and development
provenance: JAH Databases — public records organized in the Signature system
description: Acela is America's fastest train — tilting through the Northeast Corridor since 2000 at 240 km/h, making the New York–Washington run in under 3 hours. Developed by Alstom / Bombardier (United States), the Amtrak Acela is a high-speed tilting train that entered service in 2000–present.
